fallguard.desc: Privacy-first fall detection for the elderly. Turns an old phone into a smart safety camera and sends Telegram alerts with stick-figure snapshots.

VitalSync.desc: A unified mobile health app: wellness dashboard, medicine reminders, an emergency blood network and a rural health assistant.

hidden-gems.desc: A crowdsourced travel app to share secret spots, get road distances and live weather, and earn explorer badges. Live on Render.

fintrack.desc: Expense manager with spending-trend charts, payment reminders and automatic month-end archiving, built with Expo and TypeScript.
